title: OSRA Convergence Risk Summary narrative
description: What a person writes for each finding of the Convergence Risk Summary: what converges, why governance missed it, the regulatory exposure, the recommended action and the actions chosen from the catalogue (Phase 4, Step 4.3, FR-50, FR-51, FR-63), and where the finding connects to existing governance (Step 4.4). The software does not write this text. Stored as summary.yaml.

what_converges.description: Which substrate dependency, which failure mode, which trust gap.

failure_modes.description: The failure modes that converge here.

trust_signals.description: The trust gaps that converge here.

why_governance_missed.description: Which frameworks or processes should have caught it and why they did not.

regulatory_exposure.description: Which specific regulations create liability, in the practitioner's words.

clauses.description: The regulatory clauses most relevant to this finding, from the pack's mappings (Step 4.4).

recommended_action.description: Specific, prioritised steps to reduce convergence risk.

action_gap.description: Why no catalogue action applies, when none does (FR-51).

internal_document.description: Which internal governance document should address this risk but currently does not (Step 4.4).

governance_change.description: What change to existing governance is required (Step 4.4).
